did: I finished my share of My feed's Claude work. The call's readers now stop at one megabyte, so a runaway answer can't fill home's memory, and the call weeks promise holds. The render worker has a test of what it keeps and moves. The old call video routes are gone, now that the feed's videos replace them. Every gray-area call an agent makes is now written down with who made it, so a later change to one reads as you moving a story. Episodes no longer ask for your voice: home voices them, and Studio offers only Watch and Finish for an episode.

calls.title: Only the call's readers are capped, not the game feed
calls.why: The game feed keeps every response raw, so capping it means deciding what a refused one keeps, which GA3 (server#534) owns.
calls.undo: Read the game feed through get_at_most with a cap in game_feed/pass.rs.

calls.title: How the render worker's test runs one pass
options: source the script and run a pass
an environment switch for one pass
calls.why: Any of them gives one pass without the hourly sleep, and L4c (server#708) rewrites that loop next.
calls.undo: Replace the sourced guard in render-calls.sh and adapt render-calls.test.sh.

calls.title: Where a gray-area call is recorded
options: a label and an issue per call, as asks have
a record file in the repo
calls.why: #2637 left where the record lives to the owner or the session that builds it; a trailer alone can't hold the options and the undo in 100-character lines.
calls.undo: Move the entries to whichever home the owner picks and drop check:calls.

calls.title: Which calls the weekly call reads out
options: every call the owner hasn't agreed to yet
calls.why: #2637 left open whether the call voices only calls the owner hasn't heard; a new call is one they haven't.
calls.undo: Change which entries callsEntered hands the routine (call-facts.ts).

calls.title: A working definition of a gray area until yours
calls.why: The owner said they'd want to work out the definition themselves.
calls.undo: Replace the definition in CLAUDE.md, "Two kinds of pull request".

calls.title: An episode already in Studio stays, to watch and finish
options: delete the whole episode-in-Studio path and home's queue for it
keep Record on a stored episode
calls.why: A stored episode holds takes you recorded, and deleting them is your call, so ask #2782 puts it to you.
calls.undo: Bring back Record in startView and the take kind in finish.ts, or delete the episode branches and home's queue if #2782 says so.

calls.title: Who says a scene is a field of the shot
calls.why: The steps' own test only accepts top-level or shots.<key> fields.
calls.undo: Move speaker onto the take and widen the steps test.

left: FEED6's two calls are in this note and #2772's body, not yet entries in docs/calls.json.
CW5 is still unproven (#2659): nothing yet proves the lane's retry, the caps handed to the recorder, or the pinned speaker and stage.
CW6's growth per week waits on a few weeks of the call's numbers on home (#2659).
#2756 waits on the first Kokoro-voiced Playoff Delta week (Tue Nov 10): then /mission and the two mandates say you're the audience of your videos.
